card.name: Words just before a span of years
card.fires_on: Words right before a year or duration is stated, such as 'same', 'the', 'just', 'a few' or 'spent'. It also fires on the number inside a year span like '10 years'.

modes.label: Before a year
modes.description: A linking word that leads into the word year or years in a dating phrase.
modes.example: was born in 1923, the<< same>> year as Jacob Lake Inn

modes.label: Inside a span of years
modes.description: The digit or space in a count of years, such as years of schooling.
modes.example: when average schooling grows from 0 to 1<<0>> years.”

modes.label: Verbs of time spent
modes.description: A verb or adverb that introduces a length of time.
modes.example: Dewey arrived in China in 1919, and<< spent>> the following year lecturing.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict year, months and similar time-span words, including Chinese ones like 一年 and 半年.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up a time span, so the next word is likely 'year' or 'months'.
